title: NVIDIA expands Cosmos platform with training and deployment tools
summary: NVIDIA expanded its Cosmos world model platform with Cosmos Data Factory synthetic data blueprints, Cosmos Curator filtering tools, NeMo post-training pipelines, and NIM microservice deployment containers for physical AI development.
research_notes:
Curate multimodal video and sensor datasets using Cosmos Curator to filter out corrupted or non-physical sequences.

Generate synthetic physical scenarios and edge-case clips using Cosmos Data Factory blueprints deployed on cloud GPU infrastructure.

Fine-tune foundation checkpoints on domain-specific robotic or vehicle sensor layouts using NVIDIA NeMo Framework.

Deploy optimized world model checkpoints for high-throughput inference using containerized NVIDIA NIM microservices.

Employ Cosmos Curator before fine-tuning to eliminate corrupted or non-physical camera trajectories that degrade physical consistency.

Use Cosmos Data Factory blueprints to synthesize rare hazard and edge-case scenarios that are unsafe or impractical to capture in physical testing.

Deploy trained world models via containerized NVIDIA NIM microservices to leverage hardware-accelerated batching on enterprise GPUs.
